Origin and meaning

The name Karen has Danish roots and means “pure (form of Katherine)”.

About the name Karen

A Danish short form of Katherine that peaked in the mid-20th century.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Karen suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
